name: sieged-empires
description: Sieged Empires launcher — install pack and play Minecraft

scripts.prepare:pack: npm run prepare:files && npm run prepare:background && npm run prepare:icon && node scripts/prepare-pack.js
scripts.prepare:pack:mac: npm run generate:macos-manifest && npm run prepare:files && npm run prepare:background && npm run prepare:icon && node scripts/prepare-pack.js --mac
scripts.prepare:pack:win: npm run generate:windows-manifest && npm run prepare:files && npm run prepare:background && npm run prepare:icon && node scripts/prepare-pack.js --win
scripts.dist:linux: npm run prepare:pack && electron-builder --linux deb --config linux/setup-builder.json
scripts.dist:win: npm run prepare:pack:win && electron-builder --win msi --config windows/setup-builder.json
scripts.dist:win:msi: npm run prepare:pack:win && electron-builder --win msi --config windows/setup-builder.json
scripts.dist:win:zip: npm run prepare:pack:win && electron-builder --win zip --config windows/setup-builder.json
scripts.dist:win:dir: npm run prepare:pack:win && electron-builder --win dir --config windows/setup-builder.json
scripts.dist:mac: CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false npm run prepare:pack:mac && electron-builder --mac dmg --config MacOS/setup-builder.json
scripts.dist:mac:zip: CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false npm run prepare:pack:mac && electron-builder --mac zip --config MacOS/setup-builder.json
scripts.dist: npm run dist:linux && npm run dist:win
